title: Vibrant Smoky Portuguese Chicken Kebabs
description: Smoky and juicy Portuguese chicken kebabs featuring plum sauce, double-fry technique, and jain-friendly ingredients, perfect for a show-off dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together plum sauce, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Double-fry the chicken kebabs by first baking them in the oven for 15 minutes, then finishing them off in a hot skillet with a little oil until crispy and golden brown.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
